fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole boat (aluminum canoe); it can be cleaned and the aluminum polished.
findings: Dried water spots and dusty film on the floor of the canoe between the thwarts
Scuff marks and grime on the interior floor near the stern seat
Dull, oxidized-looking finish on the bare aluminum hull bottom
Faint red marking or residue near the bow on the hull bottom
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Grumman canoe. It looks solid, but the photos show some dried water spots and scuffing on the floor inside and a dull finish on the hull. We do mobile pre-sale cleanups and can wash and brighten the aluminum at your place. Would you like a quote?
